description: Gets the status or result of a job from create_schedule (or a slow validate_input). While running: progress. When done: a compact timetable as text plus a link (valid 1 hour) to the full JSON result. view='classes' (default) = one table per class, 'teachers' = one per teacher incl. preparation time, 'summary' = key figures and lists of classes/teachers only. Use 'names' to get only some classes/teachers (recommended for big schools). If impossible: the reasons.

names.description: Only these classes (e.g. '1.A') or teacher codes (e.g. 'T01')

name: get_schedule_result
title: Get timetable result
